hints.title: Quadtree Spatial Bisection
hints.text: If hasShips returns false for a region, zero ships exist inside it. Otherwise, divide into four smaller quadrants.

hints.title: Four Quadrant Partitioning
hints.text: Bisect the rectangular domain along midX and midY to produce bottom-left, bottom-right, top-left, and top-right sub-regions.

hints.title: Base Case Point Convergence
hints.text: When topRight equals bottomLeft, a true query indicates exactly one ship located at that discrete point.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: X, Y: dimensions of the grid (1000)
complexity.notes: Quadtree descent only branches along quadrants harboring ships, capped well below 400 API queries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Querying all 1000 x 1000 grid points exhausts the 400 API query limit instantly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pruning empty quadrants recursively achieves exponential query reduction.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: 2D divide-and-conquer quadtree partitioning with boundary edge-case handling.
